audit.whatIsWrong: 'Karma's Q-RQ lands root and tether' and 'She can fish for a level 2 RQ root'. The root is repeatedly attributed to Mantra-Q.
audit.why: Mantra-Q is Inner Flame plus a delayed cataclysm — damage and a slow, no root anywhere in it. The root is Focused Resolve (W): 'Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Two different abilities, two different cooldowns, two different counters. A Teemo watching her Q for a root is watching the wrong hand.
audit.corrected: The root is Focused Resolve (W), 675 range, 12s flat. Mantra-Q is damage and a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Land Blinding Shot on Karma during her Focused Resolve channel to waste the root and deny her full-tether damage'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is not a channel and a blind does not interact with it — Blinding Dart stops basic attacks. The actual counter is in Riot's own wording: 'If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Move Quick is a burst of move speed that is explicitly not cancelled by being struck, which makes it the tool for breaking a 675-unit leash before the root fires. Telling a Teemo to blind the tether wastes his one escape.
audit.corrected: Sprint out of Focused Resolve's 675-unit tether with Move Quick — break the leash and the root never fires. A blind does nothing to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere says that Karma is one of the few top laners who answers Guerrilla Warfare.
audit.why: Focused Resolve carries the revealsStealth flag and Riot's text says it damages 'and reveal[s] them'. Teemo's whole safety layer in a losing lane is standing still to go invisible; against Karma that plan has a hard counter on a 12-second cooldown. This is decisive and completely absent from both layers.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve reveals you — Guerrilla Warfare invisibility is not an escape against Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nobody mentions that Mantra needs no skill point and is live at level 1.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.' That is why her level 1 is genuinely dangerous — she has an empowered ability from the first wave while Teemo has one rank in one spell. It also means there is no 'pre-6' safety window against her the way there is against most top laners.
audit.corrected: Mantra is live from level 1 with no skill point, so her level 1 RQ poke is real. Mantra is 40/38/36/34.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'; the mid text instead says 'Max Q first and use the reduced cooldown to blind her'.
audit.why: Teemo's Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank — ranking it raises blind duration and damage, not frequency. So the advice as written promises a tempo gain that does not exist. The real windows are hers: Focused Resolve 12s flat, Inspire 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5, Mantra 40/38/36/34.
audit.corrected: Your Q is 7s flat regardless of rank. Trade on her windows: Focused Resolve 12s, Mantra 40s down to 34s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags: 'level chart contradicts data: Teemo wins 53.77% but the chart gives Karma 5/7 stages vs 1'. The two layers also disagree — content win = [Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Teemo, Karma, Karma] while full phases sides = [Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Skill, Teemo, Teemo].
audit.why: Neither chart can be right, and the content one cannot be right at all: it hands Karma both item stages in a lane Teemo wins over 1272 games, which is a large enough sample to trust. Karma is a poke-and-utility mage with no way to stop Toxic Shot on-hit scaling once Nashor's lands, and no tool that clears a shroom net. Level 1 genuinely is hers — Mantra is live and Inner Flame reaches 950 — so I kept that row and reconciled the rest toward the full layer.
audit.corrected: Reconciled both layers to [Karma, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo]: her level 1 range advantage is real, level 3 is Teemo's full kit, 4-5 is the contested window, and both item stages go to the on-hit scaling that she cannot answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags anti-heal against Focused Resolve and neither layer mentions healing at all.
audit.why: Mantra-W heals her while it extends the root — so the one time she locks you down is also the one time she recovers what your poison did. Grievous Wounds timing therefore matters in exactly the window the text tells you to fight.
audit.corrected: Mantra-W heals her while it roots you; bring Grievous Wounds before you plan to trade through it.

edits.before: Karma's Q-RQ lands root and tether before you have a blind up — respect the range and do not walk up to poke until you hit level 2.
edits.after: Mantra is live at level 1 with no skill point, so RQ Inner Flame pokes you from 950 before you have a blind — do not walk up until level 2.

edits.before: Land Blinding Shot on Karma during her Focused Resolve channel to waste the root and deny her full-tether damage
edits.after: Sprint out of Focused Resolve's 675-unit tether with Move Quick — break the leash and the root never fires

edits.before: Chain Inspire E onto herself before your Blinding Shot lands so the shield absorbs your poison burst
edits.after: Drop Inspire on herself before your Blinding Dart lands so the shield eats the poison burst underneath

edits.before: Root you with Focused Resolve and run you into your own mushrooms while you are slowed and helpless
edits.after: Tether Focused Resolve onto you — it reveals you through stealth — and drag the root into her jungler

edits.before: Kite backward with Inspire move speed after trading so your W chase never closes the gap
edits.after: Heal off Mantra-W while the root holds you, then kite away on Inspire move speed

edits.before: She can fish for a level 2 RQ root and tether you into sustained AP damage before your Q blind has any cooldown advantage; the window is hers.
edits.after: Her root is Focused Resolve, not Mantra-Q — it tethers at 675 and only fires if you fail to break the leash; at level 2 that window is hers.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where you claw back lane agency. Max Q first and use the reduced cooldown to blind her every time she steps forward for Focused Resolve — without her autos, the tether damage drops significantly and she is wasting mana on a half-combo. Push the wave when she roams and plant mushrooms at the tri-bush and river mouth so every recall path is trapped. At level 6 your mushroom network becomes the real weapon: Karma wants to roam mid or take dragon vision, and every exit from the lane is now poisoned. Force her to waste Inspire clearing your shrooms rather than peeling for her team, and deny her the peel-and-kite game by never giving her a straight chase corridor — keep shrooms on your retreat angles so even a landed RQ root punishes her as much as you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where you claw back lane agency, but not through cooldown maths on your own Q — Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank, so ranking it buys duration, not tempo. The window you actually want is hers: Focused Resolve is 12 seconds flat and Mantra is 40 down to 34. When both are spent, walk up, stack Toxic Shot and Move Quick out. When the tether lands anyway, sprint out of its 675 range to break it rather than fighting through the root, and remember it reveals you — going invisible is not an escape here. Push the wave when she roams and plant mushrooms at the tri-bush and river mouth so every recall path is trapped. At level 6 the mushroom network is the real weapon: force her to spend Inspire clearing shrooms instead of peeling for her team, and keep traps on your own retreat angles so even a landed root costs her.

edits.before: AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Karma is ranged and Mantra is live at level 1 — RQ Inner Flame pokes from 950, past anything you own. Concede the first wave.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — 12s flat, 675 range; break the tether and the root never fires. It also reveals you. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Chart reconciliation here is a judgement call and should be reviewed: I moved both layers to [Karma, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo]. Only same-length side labels were changed, so the applier's length band is satisfied. The strongest genuinely new fact in this matchup is that Focused Resolve reveals — Karma is one of the few top laners who hard-answers Guerrilla Warfare, and that appeared nowhere in either layer.
